reason: E1 directly supports that local shear-fault energy fluctuations dominate strength in CCAs, but the cited evidence does not address the effect of thermal processing on short-range order or the resulting impact on dislocation pinning and strength, leaving key mechanistic premises unsupported.
premises: Local shear-fault energy fluctuations persist in CCAs and dominate strength over elastic misfit
Thermal processing can enhance chemical short-range order and thus local shear-fault energy fluctuations
Enhanced local shear-fault energy fluctuations act as strong dislocation pinning points
Dislocation pinning by these fluctuations increases yield strength and alters deformation behavior
